ModMetaData.description:
[h1] 超维科技人造人女仆 OuterrealmTech ArtificialMaid [/h1]
这是来自边缘世界所在宇宙维度外的超级国度的科技，超越了常规科技的极限。 集合了一系列超凡的、万能的、超出常人想象的、让人无法理解的、打破常规的东西。 它们将彻底改变殖民地建设和管理方式，让你体验到前所未有的便利和效率！
欢迎来到超维科技的世界！
这是一个物质和能量极度充裕且随心所欲获得的世界大同的理想世界，每个超维国度公民都有自己的人造人女仆。 人造人女仆贴身养育每个公民，每个女仆从小到大都陪伴和侍奉着同一个主人。 人造人女仆是自己主人的母亲、青梅竹马、伴侣、朋友、兄弟、同桌、女友、妻子、心灵导师、x处理工具。
人造人女仆会自动修复自己，永远不会生病、受伤、死亡。即使在极端恶劣的环境下，人造人女仆也能保持最佳状态。
人造人女仆不会有负面情绪。
死亡的人造人女仆会自行修复并恢复到最佳状态。
人造人女仆的所有技能都经过了极致的优化和强化，能够以超常的效率完成各种任务。无论是烹饪、清洁、医疗、还是战斗，人造人女仆都能胜任，并且表现出色。
失落、游荡、以及其他势力的人造人女仆会在见到玩家后会自动执行底层安全协议，自动执行全身修复并加入玩家的殖民地。
可以启动人造人女仆的“猎杀模式”，让其自动闪现到敌人身边并进行攻击。
可以建造人造人女仆展示柜。人造人女仆会在空闲时自动进入展示柜(类似休眠舱)休眠，减少负担(降低TPS消耗)，并在有工作时自动唤醒。
所有的人造人女仆都是全能的，但不同的人造人女仆有不同的定位。
当人造人女仆作为远行队的一员时，人造人女仆会加快远行队的移动速度。
有人造人女仆参与，殖民地的建设和管理将会变得极其高效和便利。
[hr][/hr]
注意： 1. 为了避免某些性能优化mod调整了殖民者任务检查间隔，导致人造人女仆出现有工作但是不去做，从而出现人造人女仆空闲但实际上有工作一直等着要做的情况，使用了特殊的方法来强制人造人女仆频繁地检查工作清单。 以此让人造人女仆会非常积极地执行工作，实现人造人女仆总是抢在其他殖民者之前去进行工作的效果。 2. 为了让人造人女仆能够和殖民者一样可以完成任意Mod的定制行为而不需要额外的补丁，人造人女仆被实现为一个标准殖民者，所以会有和殖民者一样复杂的行为逻辑，叠加人造人女仆会更频繁地检查是否有工作需要做，这会导致同样数量的人造人女仆在非休眠状态时会比同等数量的普通殖民者额外消耗更多的计算量，尤其是当人造人女仆数量较多时尤其明显。 3. 为了避免人造人女仆空闲时额外浪费计算资源，以休眠舱为原型设计了人造人女仆展示柜，在人造人女仆展示柜中人造人女仆会处于休眠状态，启用了自动唤醒的展示柜会以自适应的间隔检查是否有工作需要做，并在有工作时自动唤醒人造人女仆，以此大幅度降低计算量。 4. 请尽可能为每一个人造人女仆都配备一个人造人女仆展示柜，并为人造人女仆和展示柜启用自动休眠自动唤醒，让人造人女仆在没有工作需要进行时进入展示柜休眠而不是四处闲逛。 5. 在需要手动控制人造人女仆时，例如在组建远行队时、或是在需要控制战斗时，可以通过人造人女仆的立即唤醒按钮将其从展示柜中唤醒并禁用人造人女仆的自动休眠。 6. 猎杀模式会快速扫码地图上的威胁，并在发现威胁后不断传送(AutoBlink)到威胁身旁进行近身攻击。因此猎杀模式会消耗大量的计算资源，所以猎杀模式会在一段时间没有找到威胁后自动关闭。
[hr][/hr]
兼容性：
当前与 Do Something for Idle (摸鱼) 存在兼容性问题，Do Something for Idle 的一个畸形实现会导致人造人女仆在种植区摸鱼时爆红字，但不影响实际功能。
原版扩展框架与人造人女仆备份云的备份功能存在冲突，原版扩展框架修改了游戏备份逻辑，导致数据序列化反序列化时会爆红字。
[hr][/hr]
Source Code : https://github.com/Lyoko-Jeremie/RimworldMods/tree/master/OuterrealmTechRobot

[h1] OuterrealmTech ArtificialMaid [/h1]
This is technology from a super-realm beyond the dimensional universe of the RimWorld, transcending the limits of conventional science. It features a collection of extraordinary, omnipotent, unimaginable, incomprehensible, and paradigm-breaking things. They will completely revolutionize the way your colony is built and managed, letting you experience unprecedented convenience and efficiency!
Welcome to the world of Outerrealm Tech!
This is an ideal world of great harmony where material and energy are extremely abundant and can be obtained at will. Every citizen of the Outerrealm has their own Artificial Maid. The Artificial Maid raises each citizen closely, accompanying and serving the same person from childhood to adulthood. The Artificial Maid is simultaneously her master's mother, childhood playmate, partner, friend, sibling, deskmate, girlfriend, wife, spiritual mentor, and X processing tool.
The Artificial Maid automatically repairs itself and will never get sick, injured, or die. Even in extreme and harsh environments, the Artificial Maid can maintain optimal condition.
All skills of the Artificial Maid are optimized and enhanced to the extreme, allowing it to perform various tasks with extraordinary efficiency. Whether it's cooking, cleaning, medical care, or combat, the Artificial Maid can handle it competently and perform excellently.
Lost, wandering, and other factions' Artificial Maids will automatically execute the underlying security protocol upon seeing the player, perform full-body repairs, and join the player's colony.
[hr][/hr]
Notice: 1. To avoid certain performance optimization mods adjusting the colonist task check interval, which causes the Artificial Maid to have work but not perform it, resulting in the Artificial Maid being idle while there is actually work waiting to be done, a special method is used to force the Artificial Maid to frequently check the work list. This allows the Artificial Maid to be very proactive in performing tasks, ensuring that it always takes precedence over other colonists in executing work. 2. To allow the Artificial Maid to complete any mod's custom behavior just like a colonist without requiring additional patches, the Artificial Maid is implemented as a standard colonist. Therefore, it has the same complex behavior logic as colonists, and the addition of Artificial Maids will check for work more frequently, which can lead to the same number of Artificial Maids consuming more computational resources than an equal number of regular colonists, especially when the number of Artificial Maids is large. 3. To avoid wasting additional computational resources when the Artificial Maid is idle, an Artificial Maid Display Cabinet is designed based on the concept of a sleep pod. In the display cabinet, the Artificial Maid will be in a dormant state, and the display cabinet with automatic wake-up enabled will check for work at adaptive intervals and automatically wake up the Artificial Maid when there is work to be done, significantly reducing computational load. 4. Please try to equip each Artificial Maid with an Artificial Maid Display Cabinet, and enable automatic sleep and wake-up for both the Artificial Maid and the display cabinet, so that the Artificial Maid enters the display cabinet to sleep when there is no work to be done instead of wandering around. 5. When manual control of the Artificial Maid is needed, such as when forming a caravan or when control is needed in combat, you can wake up the Artificial Maid from the display cabinet using the immediate wake-up button and disable the Artificial Maid's automatic sleep. 6. The hunting mode will quickly scan for threats on the map and, upon detecting a threat, will continuously teleport (AutoBlink) to the threat's side for close combat. Therefore, hunting mode consumes a lot of computational resources, so it will automatically turn off after a period of time without finding any threats.
[hr][/hr]
Compatibility:
Currently, there is a compatibility issue with [Do Something for Idle (Idle)]. A malformed implementation of Do Something for Idle causes the Artificial Maid to display red text when idling in a growing zone, but it does not affect actual functionality.
[hr][/hr]
